# Neutral-matrix probe purification rotation numerators

These are the fixed finite preparation data in the proof of [Theorem Y.8a](../../../appendices/appendix_y_baryon_asymmetry.md), component 28, for the common neutral-matrix-control probe member. The source hypotheses, complete preparation, retained records and all error bounds remain in the native proof.

## Basis and exact target probabilities

**All 512 energies and Gibbs probabilities.** Index the ordered source basis by $(i,j,k)\in\{0,\ldots,7\}^3$ and $l=64i+8j+k$. Write $e_{ijk}=E_l/Q$. With $\mathbf1_A$ denoting an indicator, every energy is defined by
$$
e_{ijk}=\begin{cases}
5+2\mathbf1_{\{k>0\}},&i=0, j=0,\\
9+2\mathbf1_{\{k>0\}},&i=0, j\in\{1,2\},\\
13+2\mathbf1_{\{k>0\}},&i=0, 3\le j\le7,\\
i+2+2\mathbf1_{\{j>0\}}+2\mathbf1_{\{k>0\}},&1\le i\le7.
\end{cases}
$$
Thus no level is omitted or reclassified as a free complement. At $b=\ln2$,
$$
Z=\sum_{i,j,k}2^{-e_{ijk}}=\frac{64691}{32768},\qquad
p_l=\frac{2^{15-e_{ijk}}}{64691}.
$$

<a id="rotation-numerators"></a>
## Exact angle numerators

Use the ordered product basis $|a,b\rangle$, $0\le a,b\le511$, with flat index $512a+b$. Starting at $|0,0\rangle$, rotation $l=1,\ldots,511$ acts on flat coordinates zero and $513l$ with
$$
 Y_l=-i|0\rangle\langle513l|+i|513l\rangle\langle0|,
$$
and is zero elsewhere. Its implemented angle is $\theta_l=a_l/2^{37}$. For the ideal probability target above,
$$
 R_l=1-\sum_{r=1}^{l-1}p_r,\qquad
 \theta_l^*=\arcsin\sqrt{p_l/R_l}.
$$
The native proof establishes $(a_l-5)2^{-37}<\theta_l^*<(a_l+5)2^{-37}$ by the complete finite sine-series comparisons. The table contains every implemented integer numerator in its execution order.
